description: Bookmark Keeper (Node, Express): seven routes work; updating a bookmark does not validate and the import route crashes on an empty body.

claims.text: POST /bookmarks saves a bookmark and refuses a missing or invalid url or an empty title with 400
GET /bookmarks lists all bookmarks, newest first
GET /bookmarks?tag=x lists only bookmarks that have the tag
GET /bookmarks/:id returns one bookmark or 404 if it does not exist
DELETE /bookmarks/:id removes a bookmark and answers 404 for an unknown id
PUT /bookmarks/:id refuses a missing or invalid url or an empty title with 400
POST /bookmarks/import with an empty or malformed body is refused with 400
